sources.quote: HD 168746 is a Sun-like star with a close orbiting exoplanet in the constellation of Serpens.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,553 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: With an apparent visual magnitude of 7.95, it is too faint to be viewed with the naked eye but is easily visible with binoculars or a small telescope.
